candidates.term: The Alchemist at the Year Gate
candidates.defline: The Alchemist stands at your Year Gate: the world’s first read of you is depth, slightly apart.
candidates.reading: This position rules Mind and Social. You arrived observant: the child at the edge of the party, cataloguing, and the adult strangers call an old soul within minutes. Your public self thinks visibly, which draws the curious and unnerves the shallow. An unusual elder or education likely seeded it. Wear the strangeness openly, it filters your company for you. The ones who stay past the silence were always your people.
